title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-06
source: SBD : FM > MR > C1 > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Clear, high‑quality FM capture of a solid Dead show with only minor rough spots.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance as a good, even "damn good" show, and note that this particular copy offers the clearest recording among the six available. The tape includes historical radio announcements and removes dead‑air tuning segments, though one reviewer mentions occasional roughness in the audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Average user rating is 4.5 stars; weighted assessment of a solid show (≈4.0) and excellent recording clarity (≈4.8) yields ~4.2. Only two reviews provide consistent, detailed feedback, so confidence is low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear FM‑broadcast capture; includes historical radio announcement and removes dead‑air tuning tracks. Generally clear but with occasional roughness noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show described as a good performance with solid pacing; no specific set‑list issues mentioned.
